name: POST /api/commands/:command_id/decision — approve/reject a gated command
description: Approves or rejects a risky command that was gated into the pending state at issue time; the decision is audited with the approving subject and optional reason. Returns 200 with the updated command. approved is a mandatory boolean, so the string "true" is rejected. tenant_id and decided_by come solely from the JWT tenant_id and sub claims - there is no body override. Edge cases: a token missing either claim is a 400; an unknown command_id and a command that is no longer pending (already approved, rejected, dispatched, or belonging to another tenant) are collapsed into the same 409 "command not found or not pending" - there is no 404 path, and this also makes a replayed decision a 409; reason is optional.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Bearer token fails JWT verification or is expired (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
The JWT carries no tenant_id claim
The JWT carries no sub claim to record as decided_by
Body is absent or approved is not a JSON boolean

errorCases.code: command not found or not pending
errorCases.message: command not found or not pending
errorCases.when: applyCommandApprovalDecision returned null - the command does not exist in this tenant, or it is no longer pending (already decided/dispatched). Replayed decisions land here
applyCommandApprovalDecision throws - non-UUID command_id (Postgres 22P02), audit-write failure, or database error
